description: The plot illustrates relative change (in percent) across grouped transformer layer ranges for four KV-cache token/precision settings, shown as four colored lines with markers. The x-axis is categorical with five groups labeled “Layer1-4,” “Layer5-12,” “Layer13-20,” “Layer21-28,” and “Layer29-32,” spaced evenly from left to right. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 5%, 0%, −5%, −15%, and −25%, spanning roughly from −25% at the bottom to 5% at the top; a horizontal dashed reference line is drawn at 0%. The yellow line with circular markers (solid) labeled “LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit” stays near zero: about 0% at Layer1-4 and Layer5-12, dips to around −2% at Layer13-20, returns to about 0% at Layer21-28, and ends slightly above 0% (around +0.5%) at Layer29-32. The red line with square markers (solid) labeled “LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit” starts at about 0% at Layer1-4, moves to roughly −1% at Layer5-12, reaches about −4.5% at Layer13-20, rises to around −1.5% at Layer21-28, and ends near 0% at Layer29-32. The light-blue line with circular markers (solid) labeled “RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit” begins near −2% at Layer1-4, is around −2.5% at Layer5-12, drops to approximately −13% at Layer13-20, rises to about −2.5% at Layer21-28, and finishes near −2% at Layer29-32. The dark-blue line with square markers (solid) labeled “RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit” starts around −3% at Layer1-4, is near −4.5% at Layer5-12, reaches its lowest point around −25% at Layer13-20, increases to about −5.5% at Layer21-28, and ends around −3.5% at Layer29-32.
